svg.text: Low-fidelity Wireframes — Registration Staff (secondary user, desktop)
Task C · red numbers = keyboard focus order · notes beside each frame give requirement, rationale and accessibility intent
T1 · Queue dashboard — before Call next (Task C)
Choose Call next for a service on the left.
T1 before — UC-12, UC-14 · FR-09, FR-10
• Focus order: 1 Counter, 2 Appointments tab, 3 Call next (Course
• This is the home screen after sign-in: everything needed for the next
call is visible without navigating (UC-14 frequency: very high).
• The service rule is stated in words under each service: a due
appointment is called first, otherwise the earliest waiting number
(Phase 1 service rule, UC-14 step 2). Staff can see why a student is
• The button names its service, because one counter may serve more than
one service (callNext takes counterId and serviceId).
• Calling is one action with no confirmation: it is cheap to correct and
a dialog would slow a very frequent task.
• The screen shows the student ID only, not names (Phase 1 data-
T1 · after Call next — called-student panel
Student ID 2021xxxxx · from the queue · called 10:41
T1 after — UC-14, UC-15 · FR-10 · BR-08
• Focus order: 1 Counter, 2 Tabs, 3 Call next (inactive), 4 Service
• The panel says who was called (ID, queue number or appointment time,
source) and where (Counter 3), as UC-14 step 5 requires.
• Grace period is shown in words and a bar; at expiry the record becomes
No-show and the panel says so (Phase 1 state model).
• Complete is large and primary. Mark no-show is separate, differently
worded and asks 'Mark queue 17 as no-show?' first, because No-show is
a terminal state that cannot be reopened (BR-08).
• Call next stays visible with the reason written on it. It is marked
aria-disabled, not removed from the tab order, so keyboard and screen-
reader users can discover why. DESIGN ASSUMPTION: one called student
per counter (UC-15 rule); the team should confirm.
• The service note has a persistent label (UC-15 step 2).
T2 · Empty and stale states (UC-14 exception 1a; connection lost)
No students are waiting or due for an
Last updated 10:41:50 · checks again every 10 s
• Left and right are two separate states, not one screen. Left, empty: a
plain statement, not styled as an error. Call next is inactive with
• Right, stale: a banner states the problem, the time of the last good
data and what is paused. 'STALE data' labels what is on screen.
• Retry now is the recovery action. Focus order: 1 Retry now (focus
moves to the banner first), 2 Call next.
• No offline caching or queued actions. Calling while offline could call
the same student twice and break the ordering rules (BR-06, report
ADR-03), so actions are paused instead.
• Unauthorised state (a service belonging to another counter, UC-12
business rule) is specified in ui-states.md.
